remarks: New, stylish and easy to live in! Welcome to Desirable & pet friendly Greenfield! Come see this conveniently located townhome and enjoy top-shelf living WITH NO ADDITIONAL FEES! Bright and warm with an abundance of windows and sunshine, unpack and enjoy a stunning, contemporary kitchen which features granite countertops, rich cabinetry, stainless appliances and opens to the living + dining areas. There are 2 generous bedrooms, including a primary bedroom + bath, both with sparkling subway tile. Two parking spaces are included in the rent. You'll also reap the economic benefits of green-built certification construction, natural gas heat, tankless hot water, central air and ceiling fans. Greenfield is a pet-friendly community with the following restrictions: 2 dogs  35lbs, 1 dog  60lbs., 2 cats or 1 dog and 1 cat are allowed. Aggressive breeds are not permitted. Greenfield is a no smoking community.  Interested applicants please submit Greenfield Application found in supplements and credit check through applyconnect ONLY. Note: This home has just been vacated and is in the process of being "made-over" - will be presented fresh and new for the next resident!
